description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for integration tests related to loan operations in the Fineract project. It includes setup methods for test helpers, utility methods for creating and managing loans, clients, and transactions, as well as verification functions for journal entries and loan status. It serves as a foundation for more specific integration test classes targeting loan functionalities.

classes.name: FeignLoanTestBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for integration testing loan functionalities in Fineract. It initializes helper clients, provides utility methods for creating and managing loans and related entities, and includes validation and verification functions for testing scenarios.

methods.name: setupHelpers
methods.description: Initializes helper instances for interacting with the Fineract API before all tests.

methods.name: getAccounts
methods.description: Returns the current account test accounts, initializing if necessary.

methods.description: Retrieves the asset account ID for a given account name.

methods.name: getLiabilityAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the liability account ID for a given account name.

methods.name: getIncomeAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the income account ID for a given account name.

methods.name: getExpenseAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the expense account ID for a given account name.
